why_it_was_acquired: The city records carry admin1 as a CODE, so nothing could render a region name from them. 986 titles collide because two cities share a name within one country, and a title cannot carry an entity id the way a URL can. This table is what turns admin1 18 into a region a reader recognises, so Woodstock, Vermont and Woodstock, New York can be told apart in copy without inventing anything.
